## Pre-alpha test release

Local Review is experimental software in an early pre-alpha stage. It is not production-ready and is not a beta release.

Use it only at your own risk. Verify review output independently and keep appropriate backups before relying on it for any workflow or decision.

## Assets

- Linux x86_64 executable
- Windows x86_64 executable
- `SHA256SUMS` for download verification

See the README for usage, keyboard shortcuts, themes, and local-note behavior.
